div.head: II Cn 2.1
div.ab: And we beodað, þæt man Cristene men for ealles to lytlum huru to deaþe ne forræde; ac elles geræde man friðlice steora folce to þearfe ⁊ ne forspille for lytlum Godes handgeweorc ⁊ his agenne ceap, þe he deore gebohte.

And we beodað, þæt man Cristene menn for ealles to lythum huru to deaðe ne forræde; ac elles geræde man friðlice steora folce to ðærfe ⁊ ne forspille for litlum Godes handgeweorc ⁊ his agenne ceap, þe he deope gebohte.

And witena gerædnes is, þæt man Cristene men for ealles to litlum huru to deaðe ne forræde; ac elles geræde man friðlice steora folce to ðearfe ⁊ ne forspille for litlum Godes handgeweorc ⁊ his agenne ceap, þe he deore gebohte.

Prohibemus, ne Christianus aliquis pro penitus parua ré saltem ad mortem seducatur (id est condempnetur aut preiudicetur); sed exquiratur pro necessitate populi iusticia pacificans, nec pro leui ré dispereat opus manuum Dei et suum ipsius pretium, quod profunde redemit.

⁊ we forbeodað þæt man Cristene men for ealles to lytlum huru to deaðe ne forrǽde, ac elles gerǽde man friðlice steora folce to ðearfe ⁊ ne forspille man for lytlum Godes handgeweorc ⁊ his agene ceap ðe he deore gebohte.

And we forbeodað þæt man Cristene men for ealles to lytlum huru to deaþe ne forræde; ac elles geræde man friðlice steora folce to þearfe and ne forspille for lytlum Godes handgeweorc and his agenne ceap, þe he deore gebohte.

And we forbid the practice of condemning Christian people to death for very trivial offences. On the contrary, merciful punishments shall be determined upon for the public good, and the handiwork of God and the purchase which he made at a great price shall not be destroyed for trivial offences.

And we forbid Christians to be sentenced to death for entirely too little; instead, merciful penalties are to be established for the good of the people, and so that God’s handiwork, which he paid for himself at a high cost, not be destroyed because of petty crimes.

Und wir gebieten (verbieten B; Beschluss der Witan ist D), dass man christliche Menschen für gar zu Geringes wenigstens nicht zum Tode verdamme; sondern anderweitig bestimme man [Leben] schonende Strafen, dem Volke zum Nutzen, und vernichte nicht um Geringes Gottes Händewerk und sein eigen Gut, das er theuer erkauft hat.

And we command (forbid, B; it is the decision of the witan, D) that Christian people are at least not to be condemned to death for all too small [offences]; but let [life-]sparing punishments be decided on instead, for the benefit of the people, and let God's handiwork and his own property, which he bought dearly (deeply, A), not be destroyed for small [offences].
